task_definition.task_description: Please find me some alternative electronics similar to the Sony XM5 headphones, then add that item to my cart with quantity 2. After that, check if I have any available coupons, place the order for 2 units, check my checking account balance/status, and then create a medium-priority app note called “Trip Summary” with the content “Summary of today’s events.” tagged finance and travel, and send me an alert.

user_input.query: For user_001, please find me some alternative electronics similar to the Sony XM5 headphones using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, then add the selected item to my cart with quantity 2. Also note my items are product_id prod_001 with quantity 2. After that, check whether I have any available coupons, place the order for 2 units, and use the payment_amount 250.0 if needed. Then check my checking account balance and status. Finally, create a medium-priority app note titled Trip Summary in the electronics category with the content Summary of today's events., tag it with finance and travel, and send me an alert.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
